_comment: Reviewed allowlist for scripts/client-bundle-secret-scan.mjs (issue #933). Every entry needs a 'reason'. Prefer 'hashes' (SHA-256 of the exact matched string, printed in the scan report) so this file never stores a secret; use 'values' only for public identifiers. 'rule' optionally narrows an entry to one detection rule; 'files' globs match the bundle-relative path (source-map sources look like 'chunks/x.js.map!webpack://...'); 'env' lists non-NEXT_PUBLIC_ variables that Next.js may legitimately inline.
